text:
Nora C.: HelixCare sent a vendor security questionnaire + DPA checklist. Asks: SOC2 cert (Type II), control mapping, dataflow diagram, embeddings retention + deletion process, KMS provenance/BYOK proof, and 90-day access logs. Renewal watch = 6 weeks. Who can own the bundle?
Lila (CS): I can own. Quick clarification: do they require evidence that embeddings never contain PHI, or just the retention/deletion process?
Ben (Security): Ask them to confirm. If embeddings may contain PHI we need to include pseudonymization SOP and our minimum controls. Also: do not send full SOC2 report; cert + mapping only.
Nora C.: Good point. Lila, please confirm PHI status in the intake form and tag us.
cs-bot: New ticket CS-5124 created: "HelixCare vendor pack" assigned to Lila (CS) due in 4 business days.
Owen (Infra): I can pull access logs (90 days) but we must run redaction first. Provide the exact identifiers (customer ID, tenant prefix).
Lila (CS): HelixCare tenant id: helix-4321. Owen, please start redaction run and attach manifest.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow redaction playbook https://confluence.redwood/security/redaction. Include a redaction manifest and proof of PII removal.
Priya (Legal): Draft cover language: "Attached: SOC2 Type II certificate and controls-to-product mapping. We do not provide full SOC2 reports without an executed NDA. For BYOK/KMS requests on Hosted accounts, we provide an attestation that encryption at rest uses cloud-provider-managed CMKs; Dedicated deployments can support customer-managed keys and HSMs."
Lila (CS): Action list: 1) Confirm PHI in embeddings with customer (I'll ask in the intake form) 2) Pull SOC2 cert + controls mapping (Nora) 3) Draw simplified dataflow PNG (Ops) 4) KMS attestation draft (Ben) 5) Request redacted logs (Owen) 6) Cover note + legal caveats (Priya).
Nora C.: I've uploaded the SOC2 cert to Drive and started a control mapping CSV. Link: /Shared/CS/HelixCare_4381234567/.
Ben (Security): Drafting KMS attestation: for Hosted accounts I'll say "Cloud-provider-managed CMKs are used for encryption at rest. We do not surface customer key material for Hosted. Dedicated/private deployments can be configured for BYOK/HSM per contract." Will add more technical detail and hand to Priya for legal phrasing.
Owen (Infra): Logs request queued: LOG-9612. ETA for redacted bundle: 48-72h. Will attach redaction manifest.
Lila (CS): Also confirming whether HelixCare embeddings include PHI. I've added a checkbox to intake and pinged their compliance contact.
cs-bot: Reminder: internal review scheduled in 48h for CS-5124.
Priya (Legal): If customer asks for mapping referencing internal ticket IDs or internal-only resources, redact those references. Also do not include vulnerability scan attachments.
Nora C.: Noted. I'll remove internal links in the mapping.
Ben (Security): If HelixCare insists on BYOK for Hosted, escalate to Sales — that is a contract/platform change. sales-bot: @here flag: Sales engagement may be required if BYOK demanded.
Lila (CS): Timeline: bundle draft to legal/security in 48h, send to customer in 72h pending approvals. Risk level = medium-high if BYOK becomes a hard requirement.
sec-bot: Add checklist item: include pseudonymization process doc if PHI present in embeddings.
Lila (CS): Got it. I'll post the Drive link and a short customer cover email for sign-off before sending.
Nora C.: Thanks everyone. Reopening thread if blockers or if HelixCare pushes for full SOC2. :white_check_mark:
